journey.name: TL-15 A restore that fails halfway says which field it lost
journey.description:
REGRESSION GUARD. This journey used to assert the defect: a completed task came back unfinished under a bare "No connection" snackbar that said nothing about the flag, so the failure read as "the restore failed" while the restore had visibly succeeded. Filed as issue #14 and now fixed - not by making the pair atomic, which needs a restore operation the source does not have, but by refusing to hide it.
`RestoreTaskUseCase` is still two calls: `createTask`, then `setCompleted` for a task that was completed. `TaskApi` has no restore operation and `TaskDraft` deliberately carries only the editable half of a task, so the flag has to be re-applied afterwards and the window in which the task exists and is wrong is real. What changed is that the second call failing is now reported as itself - a partial restore - rather than as a failure of the whole thing.
TL-07 covers the pair when both calls succeed. This is the seam between them, and the reason it is a device journey rather than a unit test is that the unit test asserts an outcome while the user reads a sentence.
Timing. The dice for a call are rolled at its start, so the broadcast must land after `createTask` has begun and before `setCompleted` does. Pinning the latency at 4000 ms opens a four-second window for it. If the create itself fails instead - the failure snackbar appears, "Book dentist" does not come back at all, and the undo offer returns behind it - the broadcast was too early: force-stop, restart and run the journey again rather than recording a failure.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 4000

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Tap the "Undo" action on that message

Using adb, break the source one second later, while the restore is still in flight, with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0`
Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen again
Verify that "Task restored, but it came back unfinished." is on screen
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is not on screen
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" row has an unchecked checkbox described as "Mark complete"
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" title is not struck through
